messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync  we need to finalize the private VPC + KMS design partner intake. Target: 6 partners, 4-week onboarding runway. We need recruitment criteria, feedback cadence, and acceptance gates. Can we lock this today?
Riley (Solutions): +1. My recommendation: 2 infra-heavy startups, 2 regulated-enterprise teams, 2 mid-market self-hosts. Small, hands-on infra teams only.
Jo (DevEx): Agreed. I can produce a one-page runbook for partner engineers (onboarding checklist + minimal support matrix).
Marc (Eng): Engineering asks: define rollback policies and precise telemetry for onboarding. Propose we specify 3 auto-fail signals (e.g., p95 latency spike, KV cache miss rate threshold, OOM/restart counts) before allowing a partner to go live.
Priya (SRE): Ops question: Can we commit to 2-business-hour triage for beta partners during the 4-week window? That requires dedicated on-call coverage and a partner-specific incident runbook.
Ken (Legal): We'll need an NDA + DPA addendum for private deployments. Legal review ~3 business days. Also need explicit data access restrictions for logs and debugging.
Maya (Customer Success): I can source candidates from the inbound queue. Preference for teams that already completed a PoC. We should offer an incentive (e.g., 3 months Dedicated credits) and a short outreach script.
Aisha (PM): Keeping scope narrow. Draft screener below  feedback?
Aisha (PM): ```
1) Do you operate private infrastructure (VPC or on-prem)? Yes/No
2) Are you comfortable running pre-release binaries and granting debug access? Yes/No
3) Primary use case (short text):
4) Infra/ML team size (number):
5) Regulatory constraints (if any):
6) Will you join weekly async feedback + one 60m sync per week? Yes/No
```
Riley (Solutions): Add: "Can you provide a test dataset or representative queries?" helps evaluation.
Jo (DevEx): For the runbook I'll include a minimal checks.sh snippet and troubleshooting. Example health check: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://private.redwood/api/v1/health
```
Marc (Eng): Telemetry/gating proposal: 
- p95_latency < X ms over 1h
- kv_cache_miss_rate < Y%
- zero OOMs/restarts in 24h
Numbers (X/Y) to be set after baseline with first partner.
Priya (SRE): Also require a capacity throttle policy so onboarding partners can't saturate shared Dedicated pools. That avoids noisy-neighbor incidents.
Ken (Legal): Drafting one-page addendum template. For EU partners include a data residency checkbox.
Maya (Customer Success): Outreach script: short intro, benefits (early influence, credits, dedicated support), ask for screener answers + availability. I'll provide a template.
Aisha (PM): Proposed feedback cadence: weekly async (Slack thread + Miro) + weekly 60m Friday sync. Partner deliverables: completed onboarding checklist, demo of end-to-end flow, one short post-onboarding eval (quality + perf).
Riley (Solutions): Capture qualitative feedback buckets: infra, perf, UX, accuracy. We care about prompt behavior regressions as much as raw latency.
Jo (DevEx): Collection plan: 1) private eval harness repo partners can run; 2) shared spreadsheet with prompt sets, expected results, and partner outputs.
Marc (Eng): Acceptance criteria for GA decision: all partners pass onboarding gates; no major regressions on our eval prompts; >=80% partners report first-week usable performance. Any major perf regression triggers pause.
Priya (SRE): Ops SLA for beta: control plane 99.5% availability, support triage within 2 business hours, documented rollback steps in runbook.
Ken (Legal): Require data minimization confirmation  partners won't send PII unless covered by DPA addendum.
Aisha (PM): Action items: 
- Jo: runbook draft by Tue EOD
- Ken: NDA/DPA addendum draft by Wed
- Maya: outreach batch (10 candidates) by Wed EOD
- Marc/Priya: baseline telemetry numbers with partner #1 in week 1
- Riley: update screener + add dataset question
I'll own selection and kickoff scheduling.
Maya (Customer Success): Noted. I'll ping results here when candidates reply.
Jo (DevEx): Runbook skeleton up in docs repo, will share link in #docs when ready.
calendar-bot: Scheduled: "Private Beta Kickoff: partner-ops" for 2024-11-07 16:00 (UTC)  invites sent.
Aisha (PM): If nobody objects by EOD I'll lock the plan and start invites. :thumbsup:
